title: arleo.eu Agent Skills Discovery Index
description: Schema for the arleo.eu /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json discovery document: a flat list of agentskills.io-style skill-md files this site publishes for agent discovery (see https://agentskills.io/specification for the SKILL.md format each entry's `url` points at). Self-hosted because agentskills.io's own specification does not define a machine-readable discovery-index format or a canonical schema host (see issue #1250) - this schema exists so the $schema field in index.json actually resolves, unlike the previous https://schemas.agentskills.io/... reference which pointed at a non-existent domain.

$schema.description: Must equal this schema's own $id so a validator can find it without prior configuration.

skills.description: Every skill-md file this site publishes for agent discovery.

name.description: Skill identifier, matching the corresponding SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

type.description: Only skill-md (a single Markdown file at `url` with agentskills.io SKILL.md-style frontmatter) is defined today; the enum is intentionally closed so a future entry type is a deliberate schema change, not silent drift.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it, mirroring the SKILL.md frontmatter description agents use for progressive-disclosure discovery.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL to the skill-md file's content.

digest.description: Optional integrity digest of the file at `url`, so a caching agent can detect a stale local copy without refetching.
